newsitem.title: UK: ATHLETICS-KENYAN RUNNERS KIRUI AND CHERUIYOT TO MARRY.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-KENYAN RUNNERS KIRUI AND CHERUIYOT TO MARRY.

text.p: Kenyans Ismeal Kirui and Rose Cheruiyot, two of the world's top long distance runners, are to be married on November 16.
Kirui, 21, won the 1993 and 1995 World Championship 5,000 metres gold medals whilst Cheruiyot, 20, is the holder of several world best times on the road.
The pair had kept their relationship a closely guarded secret until now.
Their manager John Bicourt said they expect the wedding at Kamoi, near Eldoret in Kenya's Rift Valley, to be attended by up to 1,000 people, including many of Kenya's top runners.
